Someone, somewhere, might read it and feel less alone on their own dark shore.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还沉在蓝灰色的睡梦里。街灯一盏盏地亮着，照着空荡的马路，偶尔有一辆货车缓缓驶过。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸汽从锅里升起，老板揉着面团。清洁工推着扫帚，沙沙地扫过落叶。远处的高楼只剩几扇窗还亮着灯，像疲惫的眼睛。天边泛起一线微白，鸟声渐起，城市在寂静里慢慢苏醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing a tiny bit, then asking a smaller copy of itself to solve the rest.\n• Think of standing in a line of mirrors: each mirror shows a smaller mirror inside it, until the smallest one.\n• It always needs a stopping point, like the smallest mirror, so it doesn't go on forever."}
